{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''resistance group''' fought the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on a [[Unidentified backwater planet|backwater planet]]. [[Ryenne]] considered them to be enthusiastic but overmatched. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] partnered with them in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] to [[Mission to Sunfall Peak|raid]] the [[Imperial communications hub]] on [[Sunfall Peak]].

Two [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyers]] were more Imperial firepower than they had ever seen.

==Behind the scenes==
The resistance group appears in the opening short story of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]].
